messages:
sam_sales: Starting a thread for ACMESycamore pilot scope. Need to lock down goldenset responsibility, eval pass criteria, regression cadence, pricing structure for a 3-month technical pilot, and remaining security asks. Short bullets please.

tara_de: I can set up the harness repo + CI to run daily checks. Plan: store prompts in CSV with columns (id,use_case,variant,expected,pii_flag). Will produce a baseline report after initial run.

owen_se: SE will curate the goldenset. Suggest 120 examples: 50 FAQ, 40 policy extraction, 30 actionable workflows. Include ~20 hard edge-cases for stress tests.

maria_security: Outstanding items from ACME SQ: key control model (CMK required), EU-only processing, audit log export, and DSAR handling. Also need clarification on telemetry types we retain.

rene_ps: Pricing ask: ACME wants committed monthly capacity (reserved) with a defined burst pool and an option to convert to Dedicated after pilot. I'll draft two options: (A) low-commit, higher overage; (B) mid-commit, discounted overage. Need estimated token volumes.

alex_eng: Performance constraints: ACME targets P95 latency < 2s for the guided-actions path at 256 tokens. We need to pick a model profile (1) high-accuracy quantized-llm, (2) lower-cost fast-llm. Recommend canary both. Also will enable prefix caching on FAQ.

zoe_cs: I'll book a 60-min prompt workshop with ACME SMEs. We should collect raw customer examples and label expected outputs. Action: ACME to provide 200 raw examples by Friday.

sam_sales: Great. Let's make an acceptance checklist. My quick draft: use_case_map; goldenset_owner; goldenset_size; deterministic anchors; scoring_scheme; pass_thresholds; regression_policy; perf_targets; pricing_option; security_open_items; timeline.

tara_de: Scoring proposal: multi-tier per-example score: 1.0 exact; 0.6 partial (semantic >= 0.8); 0.2 irrelevant but salvageable; 0.0 wrong. Aggregate: weighted mean. Acceptance = weighted_mean >= 0.82. Also capture model confidence mean for drift checks.

owen_se: For deterministic anchors, I'll pick 30 "must-pass" prompts that are exact-match expected. These are used for smoke tests pre-deploy.

maria_security: Confirming: anchors with customer PII must be flagged and only run in Private or with explicit consent. Also need to confirm retention period for access logs; ACME requested 12 months.

rene_ps: Sam/SEs: can you provide an estimated token/month by Monday? I'll use that to produce the two pricing options and a pilot SOW.

alex_eng: We'll provide a perf & cost projection matrix for three traffic patterns (sustained, bursty, spiky) by Monday EOD. Includes expected tokens/s and estimated monthly GPU hours.

zoe_cs: For the goldenset labels: we'll include meta tags: severity, business-impact, pii_flag, canonical_answer. Helps prioritize failures.

sam_sales: Regression gates proposal: daily automated run against full goldenset. Hard-fail if overall pass-rate drops >=4% absolute vs baseline OR if any deterministic anchor fails. Soft-alert for 1-4% drop. Any rollback requires SE + CS signoff.

tara_de: Add anomaly detector: if mean model confidence drops by >0.06 or embedding similarity distribution shifts >0.08, trigger investigation. We'll post alerts to #sales-sycamore-pilot channel.

owen_se: Also recommend manual weekly QA sampling of 50 random outputs and 10 edge cases. Keep human labels to reduce noisy alerts.

maria_security: I'll attach a short note to Legal for the contract carveouts on Hosted vs Private for CMK & EU data. Also need confirmation on whether ACME will want HSM-backed keys.

rene_ps: Timeline check: Week0: ingest examples & sign SOW. Week1: goldenset finalized & baseline run. Week2: canary testing + perf tuning. Weeks 3-4: pilot ramp. Target finish: 12 weeks including knowledge transfer.

zoe_cs: Meeting scheduled: Prompt workshop Thu 11:00 with ACME SME. Calendar invite sent.

sam_sales: Action owners recap: Owen -> goldenset + anchors; Tara -> harness + CI + anomaly detectors; Alex -> perf matrix; Zoe -> workshop & example collection; Maria -> security gaps + legal note; Rene -> pricing SOW draft. Please update me if anything slips.

calendar-bot: Event created: ACME Sycamore Prompt Workshop  Thu 11:00  60 mins.

sam_sales: Thanks team 44d keep updates in this thread so procurement/legal can track.
